name: Exp_Slow-Stoch
summary: This EA trades based on the custom Slow-Stoch indicator, offering three entry modes: zero-line crossover (breakdown), direction change (twist), and signal cloud color change (cloudtwist). It uses smoothed stochastic values to generate buy/sell signals and manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Slow-Stoch指标进行交易，提供三种入场模式：零线突破、方向转折和信号云变色。它使用平滑后的随机指标值生成买卖信号，并通过可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自定义Slow-Stoch指标，该指标是传统随机振荡器的平滑变体，通过额外施加XMA平滑算法来减少噪音。入场条件有三种模式：breakdown模式在随机值穿越50中线时入场，twist模式在随机值方向发生转折时入场，cloudtwist模式在信号云（主线与信号线关系）颜色改变时入场。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位，负值表示直接指定手数。资金管理支持多种模式（LOT等），由MMMode枚举决定。该EA还支持分别控制多头和空头的开仓与平仓权限，提供了灵活的交易控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the custom Slow-Stoch indicator, which is a smoothed variant of the traditional stochastic oscillator that applies an additional XMA smoothing algorithm to reduce noise. Entry conditions operate in three modes: breakdown mode enters when the stochastic value crosses the 50 midline, twist mode enters when the stochastic value changes direction, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal cloud color changes based on the relationship between the main and signal lines. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as reverse signal-triggered position closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where positive values represent a deposit share ratio and negative values specify a fixed lot size. Money management supports multiple modes (LOT, etc.) as determined by the MMMode enumeration. The EA also provides separate permissions for long and short position opening and closing, offering flexible trading control.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易资金比例，负值为固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lots/balance/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点）

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：突破/转折/云变色
parameters.description_en: Entry algorithm mode: breakout/reversal/cloud color change

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 提供三种灵活的入场模式，适应不同市场状态和交易风格
使用自定义平滑算法降低随机指标噪音，减少虚假信号
多空方向的开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，灵活性高
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数完善，基本风险控制到位
pros_en: Three flexible entry modes accommodate different market conditions and trading styles
Custom smoothing algorithm reduces stochastic indicator noise and false signals
Independent permission controls for long/short opening and closing provide high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Stop loss and take profit parameters provide essential risk control
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在短线信号触发时可能因高点差造成不利成交
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
无多空同时持仓检查，可能在震荡行情中频繁开平仓导致过多交易成本
依赖自定义指标文件Slow-Stoch，指标缺失时EA无法运行
SignalBar默认值为1意味着信号有延迟，设置为0时又可能增加虚假信号
cons_en: No spread filter, which may cause unfavorable fills on short-term signals with high spreads
Fixed point-based stop loss and take profit do not adapt to market volatility (ATR)
No check for simultaneous long/short positions, potentially causing frequent open/close cycles and excessive trading costs in choppy markets
Depends on the custom Slow-Stoch indicator file; EA cannot run if the indicator is missing
SignalBar default of 1 introduces signal delay, while setting it to 0 may increase false signals
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈功能，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损止盈距离
添加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，减少不利成交和过度交易风险
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt exit levels to market volatility
Add spread filter and maximum open position limits to reduce unfavorable fills and overtrading risk

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑波动率，在高波动市场可能止损过小导致频繁止损
无点差过滤机制，大点差环境下入场成本偏高
twist模式在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的来回信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit does not account for volatility; may be too tight in volatile markets causing frequent stop-outs
No spread filter mechanism; entry costs can be high in wide-spread environments
Twist mode may generate frequent whipsaw signals in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses

It uses smoothed stochastic values to generate buy/sell signals and manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
